newsitem.title: UK: Brent cargo may have traded at Jan +35 cts - trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent cargo may have traded at Jan +35 cts - trade.

text.p: A cargo of December loading Brent crude oil may have traded on Wednesday as high as Jan Brent +35 cents, traders said.
Earlier a cargo loading December 11-13 traded at Jan +30 cents -- up 20 cents from a deal on Tuesday.

There were unconfirmed reports on the market that up to three further Brent cargoes had traded on Wednesday -- a December 10-12 at Jan +33 cents, an 11-13 at Jan +35 and possibly a further cargo at Jan +30 cents. The traders said involved would not immediately confirm the deals.
